title: Energy (শক্তি)
placement: Book page 102, section 4.2 শক্তি (Energy): next to the definition "শক্তি হচ্ছে কাজ করার সামর্থ্য" and the two lines ধনাত্মক কাজ করা → বস্তুটিকে শক্তি দেওয়া, ঋণাত্মক কাজ করা → বস্তুটি থেকে শক্তি সরিয়ে নেওয়া.
description: Energy (শক্তি, page 102, 4.2) as a bicycle ride over a hill: a realistically dressed rider in a helmet on a hybrid bicycle waits at a chequered start line on a cycle race track that goes over a smooth hill 5 m high: dark asphalt with white edge lines and red-and-white kerbs, a narrow sandy run-off, a hill of packed earth with grit and ruts and orange clay around it (no green), bright advertising boards, flags and grandstands full of spectators behind, violet hills far away. The panel is one action, one result, one rule. Step ১ "প্যাডেল করে পাহাড়ে ওঠো" (the big button, or a tap on the bicycle, ringed by the same numbered badge): the rider pedals up at 3 m/s, a bold orange arrow in a white-and-dark outline shows the pedal force along the motion, and the energy bar grows: positive work gives the bicycle energy (ধনাত্মক কাজ করা → বস্তুটিকে শক্তি দেওয়া), supplied by the rider. At the top it rests with 3,430 J stored by its height (বিভব শক্তি, 70 kg × 9.8 m/s² × 5 m); a dashed line down to the road's level shows the height. Step ২ lets it roll down without pedalling: the purple potential-energy part of the bar shrinks as the amber kinetic-energy part grows, the total staying 3,430 J because friction and air resistance are left out (said in the rule); at the bottom it rolls on at about 9.9 m/s. Step ৩ brakes: a bold crimson arrow, outlined the same way, against the motion, the brake pads glow, and the energy leaves the bicycle as heat (hatched): negative work takes energy away (ঋণাত্মক কাজ করা → বস্তুটি থেকে শক্তি সরিয়ে নেওয়া). The last rule gives the book's summary: energy has no direction, it is a scalar, unit J (জুল). The row of words (ধনাত্মক কাজ, শক্তির রূপান্তর, ঋণাত্মক কাজ) jumps to each part. Test tab: 5 tap questions on frozen scenes (what the pedal force does, the energy at rest on the top, the kinetic energy read from a potential-energy label on the way down, what the brakes do, the same energy down either slope, the unit). Phone-first, Bangla.
